scope: Free-string and opaque JSON fields reachable from declared FastAPI response models, plus public prose surfaces that are not represented by a response model. Closed enum references and strings formatted as UUIDs or dates are machine types outside this prose boundary.

ownership_classes.service-authored-prose: The service creates human-readable prose. A stable code or catalog owner is mandatory.
ownership_classes.mixed-authorship: The same field may contain service-generated or user-authored text. The service-generated path needs a stable code or catalog owner; user text stays verbatim.
ownership_classes.user-authored-content: A user or operator supplies the content. It stays verbatim and is never translated as service copy.
ownership_classes.human-readable-identity: A domain label or name identifies an entity. It is data, not translatable sentence copy.
ownership_classes.machine-data: A code, trace value, filename, checksum, path, or opaque contract payload. It is not translated.

machine_fields_note: These string-serialized fields are codes, enum/status tokens, decimal values, fingerprints, versions, checksums, paths, or other machine contract data. They are enumerated so an arbitrary new string response field still fails the gate until classified.
